      color: var(--black);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon i {
      color: var(--black);
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-sm {
      padding: 8px 16px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .btn-black {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-black:hover {
      background: var(--gray-800);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-white {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--black);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .btn-white:hover {
      border-color: var(--gray-400);
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .btn-green {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .btn-green:hover {
      background: #3ec986;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 80px 0 64px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86,32,193,0.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -100px;
      left: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(85,218,155,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(85,218,155,0.15);
      color: var(--green);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      max-width: 500px;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .hero-ctas .btn {
      padding: 14px 28px;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .hero-legal {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      max-width: 520px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .hero-legal a {
      color: var(--gray-400);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .hero-legal a:hover {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    /* Category Pills */
    .category-pills {
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .category-pills-label {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .pills-scroll {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .pills-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .pill {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      color: var(--gray-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .pill:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    /* Features */
    .features {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 64px;
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .section-header p {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      padding: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      border-color: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    .feature-icon.green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.12); color: #2a9d6a; }
    .feature-icon.purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }
    .feature-icon.yellow { background: rgba(250,204,21,0.15); color: #b45309; }
    .feature-icon.blue { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.1); color: #2563eb; }

    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .feature-card p {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Stats */
    .stats {
      background: var(--green);
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stats::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      left: -10%;
      width: 50%;
      height: 200%;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
    }

    .stat-number {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }

    /* Courses */
    .courses {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .courses-header {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .courses-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .tabs-scroll {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .tabs-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .tab {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .tab:hover {
      border-color: var(--gray-400);
      color: var(--gray-700);
    }

    .tab.active {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    .courses-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .course-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .course-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      border-color: var(--gray-300);
    }

    .course-thumb {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-200), var(--gray-300));
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-thumb img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
    }

    .course-card:hover .course-thumb img {
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .course-play {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }

    .course-card:hover .course-play {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .course-play i {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--black);
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    .course-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .course-title {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .course-instructor {
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .course-stats {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .course-stats span {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .course-stats i {
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    /* Creative Feed */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .feed-card {
      padding: 40px 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .feed-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(85,218,155,0.12);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .feed-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .feed-card p {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* Teachers */
    .teachers {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teachers-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto 56px;
    }

    .teachers-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .teachers-header p {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .teachers-carousel {
      position: relative;
    }

    .teachers-scroll {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      padding: 8px 4px 24px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }

    .teachers-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .teacher-card {
      flex: 0 0 260px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .teacher-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .teacher-photo {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-200), var(--gray-300));
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teacher-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .teacher-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .teacher-name {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .teacher-specialty {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      font-size: 18px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    /* Testimonials */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      padding: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    }

    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green), var(--purple));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
    }

    /* Teams */
    .teams {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      right: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86,32,193,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .teams-content h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .teams-content p {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .teams-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .team-stat {
      padding: 28px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      text-align: center;
      transition: all 0.3s;
    }

    .team-stat:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .team-stat i {
      font-size: 28px;
      color: var(--green);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: block;
    }

    .team-stat-title {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .team-stat-desc {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    /* FAQ */
    .faq {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-list {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 24px 0;
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .faq-question:hover {
      color: var(--purple);
    }

    .faq-question i {
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-question i {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
      color: var(--purple);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.35s ease, padding 0.35s ease;
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-answer {
      max-height: 300px;
      padding-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .faq-answer p {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--gray-300);
      padding: 72px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .footer-col li {
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-col a:hover {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-logo {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
      .teams-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links {
        display: none;
      }
      .stats-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 24px;
      }
      .feed-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .testimonials-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .hero {
        padding: 56px 0 48px;
      }
      .features, .courses, .creative-feed, .teachers, .testimonials, .teams, .faq {
        padding: 64px 0;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .stats-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .hero-ctas {
        flex-direction: column;
      }
      .hero-ctas .btn {
        width: 100%;
      }
    }

    /* Animations */
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(24px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    .animate-in {
      animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease forwards;
    }

    .delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; opacity: 0; }

        image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516035069371-29a1b244cc32?w=600&h=340&fit=crop"
      }
    ];

    // Render courses
    function renderCourses(category) {
      const grid = document.getElementById('coursesGrid');
      const filtered = category === 'all'
        ? courses
        : courses.filter(c => c.category.includes(category));

      grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(course => `
        <div class="course-card">
          <div class="course-thumb">
            <img src="${course.image}" alt="${course.title}" loading="lazy">
            <div class="course-play"><i class="ri-play-fill"></i></div>
          </div>
          <div class="course-info">
            <h3 class="course-title">${course.title}</h3>
            <div class="course-meta">
              <span class="course-instructor">${course.instructor}</span>
              <div class="course-stats">
                <span><i class="ri-user-line"></i> ${course.students}</span>
                <span><i class="ri-time-line"></i> ${course.duration}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    // Tab switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
        tab.classList.add('active');
        renderCourses(tab.dataset.category);
      });
    });

    renderCourses('all');

    // Teacher carousel
    function scrollTeachers(direction) {
      const scroll = document.getElementById('teachersScroll');
      const cardWidth = 284;
      scroll.scrollBy({ left: direction * cardWidth, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // FAQ accordion
    function toggleFaq(button) {
      const item = button.parentElement;
      const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');

      // Close all
      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));

      // Open clicked if it was closed
      if (!isOpen) {
        item.classList.add('open');
      }
    }

    // Modal
    function showModal(type) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modal');
      const title = document.getElementById('modalTitle');
      const content = document.getElementById('modalContent');

      if (type === 'google') {
        title.textContent = 'Continue with Google';
        content.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn btn-white" style="width:100%;justify-content:center;padding:14px;">
            <i class="ri-google-fill"></i> Sign in with Google
          </button>
          <p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);font-size:0.875rem;margin-top:8px;">We'll redirect you to Google to complete sign-in.</p>
        `;
      } else {
        title.textContent = 'Continue with Email';
        content.innerHTML = `
          <input type="email" placeholder="Enter your email" style="width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-full);font-size:1rem;outline:none;font-family:inherit;">
          <button class="btn btn-black" style="width:100%;justify-content:center;padding:14px;">Continue</button>
          <p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);font-size:0.875rem;margin-top:8px;">We'll send you a magic link to sign in instantly.</p>
        `;
      }

      modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeModal() {
      document.getElementById('modal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Close modal on backdrop click
    document.getElementById('modal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target.id === 'modal') closeModal();
    });

    // Close modal on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
    });

    // Intersection Observer for scroll animations
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.animate-in').forEach(el => {
      el.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

The CreativeHub landing page has been built and verified. Here's a summary of what was created:

### Output
- **Main file**: `/app/output/index.html` (single-file, no build step needed)
- **Assets**: `/app/output/assets/` (available for future expansion)

### Sections Implemented
All 10 sections from `task_input.json` are included:

| Section | Key Features |
|---|---|
| **Header** | Sticky nav with blur backdrop, logo, links, Sign In/Sign Up buttons |
| **Hero** | Bold headline on black background, Google & email CTAs, legal note, horizontal scrolling category pills |
| **Features** | 4-card grid with icons (classes, pros, learning paths, certificates) |
| **Stats** | High-impact green band with 425k+ members, 30k+ classes, 9k+ teachers, 4.8★ rating |
| **Courses** | 15 category tabs with instant filtering, 8 course cards with thumbnails, instructor, students, duration |
| **Creative Feed** | 3-column grid: Stay Inspired, Stay Connected, Keep Creating |
| **Teachers** | Horizontal scroll carousel with 8 teacher cards, prev/next navigation buttons |
| **Testimonials** | 2×2 grid of student quotes with avatar initials |
| **Teams** | Dark section with content + 4 visual stat cards |
| **FAQ** | 5-item accordion — only one open at a time, smooth expand/collapse |
| **Footer** | 6-column link grid + logo + legal disclaimer |

### Interactions
- **Course tabs**: Click any category to filter the course grid instantly
- **Teacher carousel**: Arrow buttons scroll horizontally by card width
- **FAQ accordion**: Toggle open/close; clicking another auto-closes the previous
- **Sign-up modals**: Google and email buttons open contextual modals (Escape or backdrop to close)
- **Hover effects**: Cards lift with shadows, buttons have micro-interactions
- **Responsive**: Fully adaptive layout from mobile to desktop

### Design
- **Brand colors**: Black `#000000`, accent green `#55DA9B`, accent purple `#5620C1`
- **Typography**: Plus Jakarta Sans (headlines) + Inter (body)
- **Icons**: RemixIcon via CDN
- **Images**: Unsplash placeholders for course thumbnails and teacher photos
